about.title: Full stack engineering with **AI** at its core
intro: I'm a Full Stack Developer specialised in **applied AI**.

I build AI platforms for a wide range of sectors, such as healthcare or public procurement, among others. I work with **RAG systems** over knowledge bases, **agents with tools and skills**, structured outputs and mechanisms to **control and evaluate** what AI generates, on cloud architectures built for production. I take care of the whole journey, from the backend to the interface.
